rules.name: Phishing Link Detection
rules.description: Detect credential harvesting links in email via URL reputation
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 and SourceIP !startswith "10." and Account contains "admin" | summarize count() by Account, SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
